text: {"label":"Self, Well-Being, and Psychological Flexibility","definition":"Work on the behavioral self and well-being, including self-care, mindfulness, self-compassion, self-as-context and self-discrimination measures, experiential avoidance, and compassionate, person-centered clinical practice drawing on contextual behavioral approaches.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on self-related processes and well-being rather than creativity and complex behavior, self-control and impulsive choice, or behavioral accounts of theory of mind."}
